# p-try [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/p-try.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/p-try)

> [`Promise#try()`](https://example.invalid/ljharb/proposal-promise-try) [ponyfill](https://example.invalid) - Starts a promise chain

[How is it useful?](http://example.invalid/~joepie91/blog/2016/05/11/what-is-promise-try-and-why-does-it-matter/)


## Install

```
$ npm install --save p-try
```


## Usage

```js
const pTry = require('p-try');

pTry(() => {
	return synchronousFunctionThatMightThrow();
}).then(value => {
	console.log(value);
}).catch(error => {
	console.error(error);
});
```
